lab_questions.title: Find Kth Top Performing Store Revenue
lab_questions.description:
A retail chain manages N stores and records daily sales figures for each store location. Regional management requests the K-th largest daily sales amount (1-indexed) to evaluate middle-tier sales benchmarks across stores.

Read N (number of stores) and K (target rank), followed by N integers representing individual store revenues. Print the K-th highest revenue value.

tasks.title: Test Case 1
tasks.description:
Validate your code against test case 1.
Input:
5 2
1200 4500 3100 8900 2300
Expected Output: 4500

solution.python:
import sys
data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
if data:
    n, k = data[0], data[1]
    arr = data[2:n+2]
    arr.sort(reverse=True)
    print(arr[k-1])
